en.s: The Battle of Tarczek took place on 13 February 1241, during the first Mongol invasion of Poland. It ended in the defeat of the Polish armies of Lesser Poland. In March 1241, after a successful winter campaign, in which Mongol forces captured and ransacked Sandomierz, Asiatic hordes entered Poland in full force. Near Sandomierz, the Mongol forces were divided into two groups. The stronger one, probably with 15,000 warriors under Baidar and Orda Khan, headed westwards, defeating Poles in the Battle of Chmielnik. The second army, with 10,000 warriors under Kadan (according to Jan Długosz) headed northwards, to the Land of Łęczyca and Kujawy.

zh.s: 1241年2月13日，蒙古首次入侵波兰期间发生塔尔切克战役，小波兰地区的波军战败。原文随后记载，蒙古军在冬季战役中攻占并洗劫桑多梅日后，于1241年3月大举进入波兰，在桑多梅日附近分成两路。较强的一路可能有15000名战士，由拜答儿和斡儿答汗率领西进，并在赫梅尔尼克战役中击败波军。另一路据扬·德乌戈什记载，由合丹率一万战士向北进军文奇察和库亚维地区。后文3月的叙述晚于开头所列战役日期。

en.s: The Battle of Tursko (or Tursko Wielkie) took place on 13 February 1241, during the First Mongol invasion of Poland. It ended in the defeat of the Polish forces of the ziemia of Kraków. In early February 1241, Polish forces under the voivode of Kraków Włodzimierz blocked the road towards Kraków, concentrating in the area of Miechów. Meanwhile, Mongol forces headed towards Kraków via Koprzywnica, Wiślica and Skalbmierz, then withdrew to Tursko Wielkie. Following the order of the voivode, the Poles decided to pursue the Mongols. The Mongol commander Baidar was probably aware of it, using mock retreat to find a better position for the battle.

zh.s: 图尔斯科战役又称大图尔斯科战役，发生于蒙古首次入侵波兰期间的1241年2月13日，克拉科夫地区的波军战败。2月初，克拉科夫总督弗沃齐米日率波军集结米胡夫，阻断通往克拉科夫的道路。蒙古军经科普日夫尼察、维希利察和斯卡尔布梅日向克拉科夫推进，随后退至大图尔斯科。波军奉总督之命决定追击。蒙古指挥官拜答儿很可能已知此事，利用佯退寻找更有利的战场。

en.s: The sack of Sandomierz during the first Mongol invasion of Poland took place on 13 February 1241. It ended in the victory of the Mongol forces, who captured the city and burned it, massacring the residents. During the Mongol invasion of Poland, southeastern Polish city of Sandomierz was regarded by the invaders as a strategically important location, which had to be captured.

zh.s: 1241年2月13日，蒙古首次入侵波兰期间，蒙古军攻占波兰东南部城市桑多梅日，焚毁城市并屠杀居民。入侵者认为桑多梅日具有重要战略地位，必须攻占。

en.s: The Siege of Baghdad, also known as the Sack of Baghdad, took place in early 1258. A large army commanded by Hulegu, a prince of the Mongol Empire, attacked the historic capital of the Abbasid Caliphate after a series of provocations from its ruler, caliph al-Musta'sim. Within a few weeks, Baghdad fell and was sacked by the Mongol army—al-Musta'sim was killed alongside hundreds of thousands of his subjects.
en.n: Siege of Baghdad: Hulegu Khan, a prince of the Mongol Empire, orders his army to sack and plunder the city of Baghdad, which they had just captured.

zh.s: 巴格达围城战又称巴格达陷落，发生于1258年初。蒙古帝国王子旭烈兀率大军进攻阿拔斯哈里发国的古都巴格达，起因是该国统治者哈里发穆斯台绥木的一系列挑衅。数周后，巴格达陷落并遭蒙古军队洗劫；穆斯台绥木及数十万臣民被杀。
zh.n: 巴格达围城战期间，蒙古帝国王子旭烈兀下令洗劫刚被攻占的巴格达。

en.s: The Battle of the Bosporus or Bosphorus took place on 13 February 1352 during the War of the Straits, between the fleet of the Republic of Genoa on one side and an allied fleet of the Republic of Venice, the Crown of Aragon, and the Byzantine Empire on the other.

zh.s: 博斯普鲁斯海战发生于1352年2月13日，是海峡战争的一部分。交战一方是热那亚共和国舰队，另一方是威尼斯共和国、阿拉贡王国和拜占庭帝国的联合舰队。

en.s: The Treaty of Westminster (or the Treaty of Westminster-Ardtornish) was signed on 13 February 1462 between Edward IV of England of the House of York and the Scottish John of Islay, Earl of Ross, Lord of the Isles.

zh.s: 威斯敏斯特条约又称《威斯敏斯特—阿德托尼什条约》，于1462年2月13日由英格兰约克王朝国王爱德华四世与苏格兰洛恩领主、群岛之王罗斯伯爵约翰签署。

en.s: On 13 February 1503, thirteen Italian knights led by Ettore Fieramosca fought thirteen French knights near Barletta, in present-day Italy. The Italians won the encounter remembered as the Challenge of Barletta.

zh.s: 1503年2月13日，埃托雷·菲耶拉莫斯卡率领13名意大利骑士，在今意大利巴列塔附近与13名法国骑士比武。意大利一方获胜，这场比武后来被称为“巴列塔挑战赛”。

en.t: Catherine Howard, the fifth wife of Henry VIII of England, is executed for adultery
en.s: Catherine Howard (c. 1523 – 13 February 1542) was Queen of England from July 1540 until November 1541 as the fifth wife of King Henry VIII. She was the daughter of Lord Edmund Howard and Joyce Culpeper, a first cousin to Anne Boleyn (the second wife of Henry VIII), and the niece of Thomas Howard, 3rd Duke of Norfolk.

zh.t: 凯瑟琳·霍华德因通奸罪被处决
zh.s: 凯瑟琳·霍华德（约1523年—1542年2月13日）于1540年7月至1541年11月担任英格兰王后，是亨利八世的第五任妻子。她是埃德蒙·霍华德勋爵与乔伊斯·卡尔佩珀之女，也是亨利八世第二任妻子安妮·博林的表亲，以及诺福克第三公爵托马斯·霍华德的侄女。

en.t: Charles XI succeeds to Sweden’s throne as a child
en.s: On 13 February 1660 in the calendar then used in Sweden, the four-year-old Charles XI succeeded his father, Charles X Gustav, as king. A regency governed during his minority.
en.n: February13 is the OldStyle date used in the source’s reign field. The entry does not claim peace negotiations all began that same day.

zh.t: 年幼的卡尔十一世继承瑞典王位
zh.s: 按瑞典当时使用的历法，1660年2月13日，四岁的卡尔十一世在父亲卡尔十世·古斯塔夫去世后继承王位。他未成年期间由摄政政府执政。
zh.n: 2月13日采用原文在位日期所列的旧历日期，不表示所有和谈都在当天开始。

en.s: Early in the morning of 13 February 1692, in the aftermath of the Glorious Revolution and the Jacobite uprising of 1689 led by John Graham of Claverhouse, a massacre took place in Glen Coe, in the Highlands of Scotland. This incident is referred to as the massacre of Glencoe, or in Scottish Gaelic Mort Ghlinne Comhann, or murder of Glen Coe. The massacre began simultaneously in three settlements along the glen—Invercoe, Inverrigan, and Achnacon—although the killing took place all over the glen as fleeing MacDonalds were pursued.

zh.s: 1692年2月13日清晨，在光荣革命及克拉弗豪斯的约翰·格雷厄姆领导的1689年詹姆斯派起义之后，苏格兰高地格伦科发生屠杀。行动同时始于峡谷沿线的因弗科、因弗里根和阿赫纳康三个居民点，但逃跑的麦克唐纳家族成员遭到追杀，杀戮遍及整条峡谷。

en.s: The Battle of Palanga, or the Battle of Polangen, was fought on 13 February 1705 between a Swedish army commanded by Joachim Danckwardt and a Russian–Lithuanian army under Iwan Stephan Gogaron Morbirun. Danckwardt was sent to Palanga in Samogitia with 387 cavalry to reopen the line of communication between Courland and eastern Prussia, in which he was successful.

zh.s: 1705年2月13日，约阿希姆·丹克瓦特率瑞典军队，与伊万·斯特凡·戈加龙·莫尔比伦指挥的俄国—立陶宛军队在帕兰加交战。丹克瓦特奉命率387名骑兵前往萨莫吉希亚的帕兰加，重新打通库尔兰与东普鲁士之间的交通线，并成功完成任务。

en.s: The Mapuche uprising of 1723 was a rebellion of the Mapuche (an Indigenous people of western South America) against the Spanish Empire and its colonial administration in present-day Chile. It began with the killing of Pascual Delgado by Mapuches and continued until Mapuche factions begun to sue for peace in 1725. The Spanish reinforced the fort of Purén, and most of the Spanish managed to find refuge in the various forts without being intercepted or harassed by Mapuches. On August Mapuche toki Vilumilla pushed north occupying Isla del Laja, that is the lands between Bío Bío and Laja rivers. The Spanish led by Manuel de Salamanca attacked a Mapuche encampment of warriors August 24, a day of heavy rain. The Mapuche initially fought with tenacity but came to believe they were being surrounded so they fled the scene. Eventually, peace was established by treaty again on February 13, 1726 in the Parliament of Negrete.

zh.s: 1723年马普切起义，是南美西部原住民马普切人反抗西班牙帝国及其在今天智利境内殖民政府的行动。起义始于马普切人杀死帕斯夸尔·德尔加多，持续到1725年各派开始求和。西班牙人增援普伦堡，多数西班牙人成功躲入各处堡垒，未被马普切人拦截或袭扰。8月，马普切军事领袖维卢米利亚北进，占领比奥比奥河与拉哈河之间的“拉哈岛”地区。8月24日大雨中，曼努埃尔·德·萨拉曼卡率西班牙军袭击马普切战士营地。马普切人起初顽强抵抗，后来误以为遭包围而逃离。双方最终于1726年2月13日在内格雷特会议上再次缔约，实现和平。

en.s: The Treaty of Giyanti (also known as the Treaty of Gianti Java, the Gianti Agreement, or the Giyanti Treaty) was signed and ratified on February 13, 1755, between Prince Mangkubumi, the Dutch East India Company, and Sunan Pakubuwono III along with his allies. The accord officially divided the Sultanate of Mataram between Mangkubumi and Pakubuwono.

zh.s: 吉扬蒂条约又称爪哇吉安蒂条约或吉安蒂协定，于1755年2月13日签署并批准。签约方为王子芒库布米、荷兰东印度公司、苏南·巴库布沃诺三世及其盟友。协议正式将马打兰苏丹国一分为二，由芒库布米和巴库布沃诺分别统治。

en.s: The 1777 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on February 13, 1777, in order to elect the First Governor of Maryland. Candidate Thomas Johnson was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against Samuel Chase and other candidates.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1777年2月13日举行首任州长选举。州议会选出托马斯·约翰逊，击败塞缪尔·蔡斯及其他候选人。

en.s: The Battle of Sultanabad (Persian: نبرد سلطان‌آباد) occurred on 13 February 1812, between the Russian Empire and the Persian Empire. In the resulting battle, the Russians were surrounded and routed. The Persians, numerically superior, were led by Crown Prince Abbas Mirza. A Persian offensive into Georgia, with Persia's British and French-trained Nezam-e Jadid infantry, initiated the battle. The Persians had also obtained European cannons from the French.

zh.s: 苏丹阿巴德战役于1812年2月13日发生，交战双方是俄罗斯帝国和波斯帝国。俄军遭包围并被击溃。波斯军队人数占优，由王储阿巴斯·米尔扎指挥。波斯向格鲁吉亚发动进攻，使用由英法训练的新式步兵“尼扎姆-贾迪德”，战役由此爆发；波斯还从法国获得欧洲火炮。

en.s: The Crossing of the Andes (Spanish: Cruce de los Andes) was one of the most important feats in the Argentine and Chilean wars of independence. A combined army of Argentine soldiers and Chilean exiles crossed the Andes mountains (which separate Argentina from Chile) to invade Chile, leading to its liberation from Spanish rule.

zh.s: 安第斯山脉翻越行动是阿根廷和智利独立战争中最重要的军事行动之一。阿根廷士兵与流亡智利人组成联军，翻越分隔阿根廷和智利的安第斯山脉，入侵智利，最终使智利摆脱西班牙统治。

en.s: The Battle of Vacacai, also known as the Battle of Bacacay or Vacacay, was a small skirmish fought on 13 February 1827 between a small militia cavalry force of the Imperial Brazilian Army and an Argentine detachment in the context of the Cisplatine War.

zh.s: 1827年2月13日，巴西战争期间，巴西帝国陆军一支小型民兵骑兵队与阿根廷分遣队发生瓦卡凯战斗，也称巴卡凯战斗。这是一场小规模交战。

en.s: The siege of Gaeta was the concluding event of the war between the Kingdom of Sardinia and the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, part of the unification of Italy. It started on 5 November 1860 and ended on 13 February 1861, and took place in Gaeta, in today's Southern Lazio (Italy).

en.s: The Battle of Middle Boggy sometimes called either Battle of Middle Boggy River or Battle of Middle Boggy Depot, took place on February 13, 1864 in Choctaw Indian Territory, 4 miles (6.4 km) south of what is now Allen in Pontotoc County, Oklahoma. Advancing down the Dragoon Trail toward Fort Washita, Union Colonel William A. Phillips sent out an advance of approximately 350 men from the 14th Kansas Cavalry (led by Maj. Charles Willetts) and two howitzers (led by Captain Solomon Kaufman) to attack a Confederate outpost guarding the Trail's crossing of Middle Boggy River.

zh.s: 1864年2月13日，双方在乔克托印第安领地、今天俄克拉何马州庞托托克县艾伦以南四英里（6.4公里）处交战，称为米德尔博吉战斗、米德尔博吉河战斗或米德尔博吉据点战斗。联邦军威廉·A.菲利普斯上校沿龙骑兵道向沃希托堡推进，派出查尔斯·威利茨少校率堪萨斯第14骑兵团约350人，以及所罗门·考夫曼上尉指挥的两门榴弹炮，攻击守卫米德尔博吉河渡口的联盟军哨所。

en.s: The second passage of Curupayty was a naval operation carried out by the Imperial Brazilian Navy in the Paraguayan War on 13 February 1868, which aimed to force, once again, the passage of the Curupayty Fort. This time the passage was carried out by the new Brazilian monitors Alagoas, Pará and Rio Grande, in addition to some other wooden ships. The fleet faced thirty artillery pieces for an hour.

zh.s: 1868年2月13日，巴西帝国海军在巴拉圭战争期间再次强行通过库鲁帕伊蒂要塞，展开第二次库鲁帕伊蒂渡河行动。巴西新式浅水炮舰“阿拉戈阿斯”号、“帕拉”号和“南大河”号等木制舰艇参与行动。舰队在炮火下坚持了一小时。

This election was for all of the 72 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 52 single-member constituencies, six 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

en.s: The Lạng Sơn campaign (3 to 13 February 1885) was a major French offensive in Tonkin (northern Vietnam) during the Sino-French War (August 1884–April 1885). The Tonkin Expeditionary Corps, under the command of General Louis Brière de l'Isle, defeated the Chinese Guangxi Army and captured the strategically important town of Lạng Sơn in a ten-day campaign mounted under formidable logistical constraints.

zh.s: 谅山战役于1885年2月3日至13日进行，是中法战争期间法国军队在东京地区（今越南北部）发动的一次重要攻势。路易·布里埃·德·利尔将军指挥的东京远征军在后勤条件十分艰难的情况下，用十天击败中国广西军并攻占战略要地谅山。

en.s: The 1886 Scottish Cup final was the 13th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1885–86 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match was played at Cathkin Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 13 February 1886, and was watched by a crowd of "between 7,000 and 8,000", "between 8,000 and 9,000", or "not less than 9,000", or 10,000 spectators.

zh.s: 1886年苏格兰杯决赛是第13届决赛，决定1885—1886赛季冠军。苏格兰杯是当地最负盛名的淘汰制足球赛事。比赛于1886年2月13日在克罗斯希尔的卡思金公园举行，该地如今已是格拉斯哥的一部分。关于观众人数，各记载不同，分别称7000至8000人、8000至9000人、不少于9000人，或一万人。

en.s: The City of Christchurch by-election of 1896 was a by-election held on 13 February 1896 during the 12th New Zealand Parliament in the urban seat of the City of Christchurch. The by-election was triggered by the appointment of William Pember Reeves as Agent-General to the United Kingdom. The Liberal Government led by Richard Seddon had trouble finding a suitable candidate and delayed Reeves' resignation until the day he left his home in Christchurch to take up the London post. Nonetheless, rumours of Reeves' pending resignation had been circulating for a month and candidates were lining up.

zh.s: 新西兰第12届议会任内，基督城市选区于1896年2月13日举行补选。威廉·彭伯·里夫斯获任驻英国总代理，议席因此出缺。理查德·塞登领导的自由党政府难以找到合适候选人，直到里夫斯离开基督城家中前往伦敦任职当天，才让其正式辞职。不过，他即将辞职的传言已流传一个月，候选人早已开始准备。

en.s: The Battle of Jieznas (Lithuanian: Jiezno kautynės; 10–13 February 1919) was one of the first battles of the recreated Lithuanian Army against the Red Army near Jieznas during the Lithuanian Wars of Independence. This Lithuanian victory contributed significantly to an increase in Lithuanian morale. The further Bolshevik offensive into Lithuania was stopped at the battles of Kėdainiai, Jieznas and Alytus.

en.s: The Channel Dash (German: Unternehmen Zerberus, Operation Cerberus) was a German naval operation during the Second World War. A Kriegsmarine (German Navy) squadron, comprising the two Scharnhorst-class battleships, Scharnhorst and Gneisenau, the heavy cruiser Prinz Eugen and their escorts was evacuated from Brest in Brittany to German ports. Scharnhorst and Gneisenau had arrived in Brest on 22 March 1941 after the success of Operation Berlin in the Atlantic.

The offensive near the town of Krasny Bor formed the western arm of the pincer.

en.t: An allegedly 500,000-year-old rock is discovered near Olancha, California, US, that appears to anachronistically encase a spark plug
en.s: The Coso artifact is an object falsely claimed by its discoverers to be a spark plug encased in a geode. Discovered on February 13, 1961, by Wallace Lane, Virginia Maxey, and Mike Mikesell while they were prospecting for geodes near the town of Olancha, California, it has long been claimed as an example of an out-of-place artifact. The artifact has been identified as a 1920s-era Champion spark plug encased in a concretion.

zh.t: 加州奥兰查附近发现一块据称有50万年历史、内部似乎包裹着火花塞的岩石
zh.s: 科索文物是一件物品，发现者曾错误地声称它是一枚包裹在晶洞中的火花塞。1961年2月13日，华莱士·莱恩、弗吉尼亚·马克西和迈克·米克塞尔在加州奥兰查镇附近勘探晶洞时发现了它。长期以来，它被用作“时代错置物品”的例子；实际鉴定结果显示，它是一枚1920年代的冠军牌火花塞，包裹在结核体中。

en.s: The 1976 Nigerian coup d'état attempt was a military coup attempt which took place in Nigeria on 13 February 1976 when a faction of Armed Forces officers, led by Lieutenant Colonel Bukar Suka Dimka, attempted to overthrow the government of General Murtala Mohammed (who himself took power in the 1975 coup d'état).

en.s: The Sydney Hilton bombing occurred on 13 February 1978, when a bomb exploded outside the Hilton Hotel in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. At the time the hotel was the site of the first Commonwealth Heads of Government Regional Meeting (CHOGRM), a regional offshoot of the biennial meetings of the heads of government from across the Commonwealth of Nations. The bomb was planted in a rubbish bin and exploded when the bin was emptied into a garbage truck outside the hotel at 1:40 a.m. It killed two garbage collectors, Alec Carter and William Favell.

zh.t: 悉尼希尔顿酒店爆炸案
zh.s: 1978年2月13日，澳大利亚新南威尔士州悉尼希尔顿酒店外发生炸弹爆炸。当时酒店正举办首届英联邦政府首脑区域会议，这是每两年举行的英联邦政府首脑会议的地区性分会。炸弹被放在垃圾桶内，凌晨1时40分，垃圾桶被倒入酒店外的垃圾车时爆炸，炸死清洁工阿莱克·卡特和威廉·法维尔。

en.s: Cinema Statuto was a movie theater located in Turin, Italy, when on 13 February 1983, at 18:15, during the projection of La Chèvre, a fire caused the death of 64 people as a result of smoke inhalation. According to statements by Raimondo Capella, the owner of the cinema, the flames spread from an old curtain. The victims, although they had tried to escape, found the exits closed and locked, so could not avoid the fumes of Hydrogen cyanide, a product of combustion of fire-resistant fabric chairs.

zh.s: 1983年2月13日18时15分，意大利都灵斯塔图托电影院放映《霉运侦探》期间发生火灾，64人吸入烟气死亡。影院老板雷蒙多·卡佩拉称，大火从一幅旧窗帘蔓延。遇难者虽试图逃生，却发现出口关闭并上锁，无法避开由阻燃织物座椅燃烧产生的氰化氢烟气。

en.s: The Kokkilai offensive was an attack on the Sri Lanka Army encampment in Kokkilai, Mullaitivu District, Sri Lanka, on the night of 13 February 1985 by the Tamil Tigers. en.s: The Amiriyah shelter bombing was an aerial attack that killed at least 408 civilians on 13 February 1991 during the Persian Gulf War, when an air-raid shelter ("Public Shelter No. 25"), in the Amiriyah neighborhood of Baghdad, Iraq, was destroyed by the U.S. Air Force with two laser-guided "smart bombs". The shelter was used in the Iran–Iraq War and the Persian Gulf War by hundreds of civilians. According to the U.S. military, the shelter at Amiriyah had been targeted because it fit the profile of a military command center; electronic signals from the locality had been reported as coming from the site, and spy satellites had observed people and vehicles moving in and out of the shelter.

zh.t: 阿米里亚防空洞遭轰炸
zh.s: 1991年2月13日，海湾战争期间，美国空军用两枚激光制导“智能炸弹”，摧毁伊拉克巴格达阿米里亚社区的“第25公共防空洞”，造成至少408名平民死亡。数百名平民曾在两伊战争和海湾战争期间使用这处掩体。美军称，将其列为目标是因为它符合军事指挥中心的特征：据报当地电子信号来自该处，间谍卫星也观察到人员和车辆进出。

For the first time under Zuffa ownership, the show was held in Rio Rancho, New Mexico and not the usual spot of Las Vegas, Nevada. The event drew an estimated 268,000 viewers on Versus, a record low for the WEC.

zh.s: WEC 32：新墨西哥，是世界极限笼斗组织（WEC）于2008年2月13日星期三举办的综合格斗赛事。这是WEC归Zuffa所有后，首次在新墨西哥州里奥兰乔举办赛事，而非惯常的内华达州拉斯维加斯。赛事在Versus频道约吸引268000名观众，创下WEC收视新低。

en.s: The 2010 Pune bombing occurred on 13 February 2010 at approximately 7:15 pm IST when a bomb exploded at the German Bakery in the city of Pune, Maharashtra, India. The blast killed 17 people, and injured at least 60 more, including an Italian woman, two Sudanese students, and an Iranian student. The German Bakery is located near the Jewish Chabad House and the Osho ashram (an international meditation resort) in Koregaon Park, Pune. The ashram and the bakery are frequented by foreigners and the bakery, which is popular with tourists and locals alike, was busy at the time of the blast.

zh.s: 2010年2月13日印度标准时间晚7时15分左右，印度马哈拉施特拉邦浦那的德国面包坊发生炸弹爆炸，造成17人死亡、至少60人受伤，受伤者中包括一名意大利女性、两名苏丹学生和一名伊朗学生。面包坊位于浦那科雷冈公园区，靠近犹太教哈巴德中心及奥修修行中心，后者是一处国际冥想度假地。外国人常到修行中心和面包坊，面包坊也深受游客及当地人欢迎，爆炸时顾客众多。

en.s: Operation Moshtarak (Dari for Together or Joint), also known as the Battle of Marjah, was an International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) pacification offensive in the town of Marjah, Helmand Province, Afghanistan. It involved a combined total of 15,000 Afghan, American, British, Canadian, Danish, and Estonian troops, constituting the largest joint operation of the War in Afghanistan up to that point.

en.s: The Battle of Bacho (Thai: การปะทะที่บาเจาะ; Malay: Pertempuran Bacho) was a battle during the South Thailand insurgency between forces of the Royal Thai Marine Corps (RTMC) and Runda Kumpulan Kecil (RKK) insurgents, which began when the latter attacked a Thai marines base in Bacho District, Narathiwat Province on 13 February 2013.

zh.s: 巴乔战役是泰国南部动乱期间的一场战斗，交战双方是泰国皇家海军陆战队和小组武装分子（RKK）。2013年2月13日，RKK武装人员袭击了位于那拉提瓦府巴乔县的一处泰国海军陆战队基地，战斗由此爆发。

en.s: The Wythenshawe and Sale East by-election was a by-election held on 13 February 2014 for the Parliament of the United Kingdom's House of Commons constituency of Wythenshawe and Sale East, following the death of the former MP, Paul Goggins. The election was won by Mike Kane of the Labour Party with a greatly increased share of the vote compared with the 2010 general election. UKIP, which had previously performed poorly, came second, beating the Conservative Party into third place. The Liberal Democrats lost their deposit. The turnout was 28.2%, compared with 54.3% for the 2010 general election.

zh.t: 2014年威森肖和塞尔东选区补选
zh.s: 英国下议院威森肖和塞尔东选区于2014年2月13日举行补选，原因是议员保罗·戈金斯去世。工党的迈克·凯恩获胜，得票率较2010年大选大幅提高。此前表现不佳的英国独立党升至第二，保守党降至第三，自由民主党则失去选举保证金。投票率为28.2%，而2010年大选为54.3%。

en.s: The 2015 Saudi Crown Prince Cup final was the 40th final of the Crown Prince Cup. It took place on 13 February 2015 at the King Fahd International Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and was contested between Al-Ahli and Al-Hilal. It was Al-Ahli's 12th Crown Prince Cup final and Al-Hilal's 15th final. This was the fourth meeting between these two clubs in the final Al-Hilal won all previous meetings.

zh.s: 第40届沙特王储杯决赛于2015年2月13日在沙特阿拉伯利雅得法赫德国王国际体育场举行，由吉达国民对阵利雅得新月。这是国民第12次、新月第15次进入王储杯决赛，也是两队第四次在决赛相遇，前三次均由新月获胜。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Haiti on 13 and 14 February 2016 following the annulment of the results of the 2015 elections by the Provisional Electoral Council, and after Michel Martelly resigned the presidency and Prime Minister Evans Paul assumed office as acting president on 7 February 2016. The members of the National Assembly voted for the interim President on 13 February 2016 in the first round and on 14 February in the second round.

en.s: The 2016 Singapore Community Shield (also known as the Great Eastern Community Shield for sponsorship reasons) was the 9th edition of the Singapore Community Shield held on 13 February 2016 at Jalan Besar Stadium, between the winners of the previous season's S.League and Singapore Cup competitions. The match was contested by 2015 Singapore Cup winners Albirex Niigata (S) and 2015 S.League champions DPMM FC.

zh.s: 2016年新加坡社区盾杯又称大东方社区盾杯（赞助名称），是该项赛事的第9届比赛，于2016年2月13日在惹兰勿刹体育场举行，由上赛季新加坡职业足球联赛和新加坡杯冠军球队对阵。参赛队伍为2015年新加坡杯冠军新潟天鹅新加坡队和2015年新加坡职业足球联赛冠军文莱DPMM队。

zh.s: 2016年丰田超级杯是第6届丰田超级杯，比赛由丰田汽车和泰国足协共同举办，采用单场决胜制。参赛队伍为2015年泰国联赛杯冠军武里南联队和受邀参赛的日本球队新潟天鹅，该队在2015年日本J1联赛中参赛。比赛在i-mobile体育场举行，由丰田汽车赞助。

en.s: On 13 February 2017, Kim Jong-nam, the older half-brother of the North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, was assassinated at Kuala Lumpur International Airport in Malaysia. He had been living abroad since his exile from North Korea in 2003. Following his visit to the resort island Langkawi, Kim Jong-nam arrived at terminal 2 sometime before 9:00 a.m. to take a 10:50 a.m. AirAsia flight to Macau.

zh.s: 2017年2月13日，朝鲜领导人金正恩同父异母的兄长金正男，在马来西亚吉隆坡国际机场遇刺。金正男自2003年被逐出朝鲜后一直居住国外。他游览度假胜地兰卡威岛后，于当日上午9时前抵达机场第二航站楼，准备搭乘10时50分飞往澳门的亚洲航空航班。

en.s: The 2018 Oklahoma City mayoral election took place on February 13, 2018. Incumbent Mayor Mick Cornett did not seek re-election to a fifth term, instead opting to unsuccessfully run for Governor in the Republican primary. Republican State Senator David Holt ran to succeed Cornett and faced two little-known opponents, University of Oklahoma student Taylor Neighbors and accountant Randall Smith.

en.t: 2024 New York's 3rd congressional district special election
en.s: The 2024 New York's 3rd congressional district special election was held on February 13, 2024, to fill the vacant seat in New York's 3rd congressional district for the remainder of the 118th United States Congress. The seat became vacant after the expulsion of Republican George Santos on December 1, 2023. Considered a suburban swing seat, political analysts predicted a competitive and expensive election for both parties.

zh.s: 纽约州第三国会选区于2024年2月13日举行特别选举，填补第118届美国国会的空缺席位。共和党籍众议员乔治·桑托斯于2023年12月1日被开除后，该席位空缺。分析人士认为这是一个郊区摇摆选区，预计两党将展开竞争激烈、花费高昂的选举。
